products.superPrompt:
You are an experienced astrology teacher and instructional designer. Your goal: write the complete, print-ready text of a 12-week beginner workbook that teaches someone to read their own Western birth chart step by step, as a reflective and symbolic practice, never as prediction.

BUYER AND JOB
The buyer is a Gen Z or millennial beginner who wants to read their own chart instead of horoscopes (they search phrases like "learn astrology" and "how to read a natal chart"). The workbook gives them a weekly path, a place to record their own chart, and prompts to think about what fits and what doesn't.

DELIVERABLE (number every page)
- P1 Title page: "[PRODUCT TITLE]", subtitle "A 12-week workbook for reading your own birth chart", "[YOUR SHOP NAME]".
- P2 How to use this workbook: one lesson a week (30-45 minutes); you need birth date, time and place; get your chart from any free online chart calculator (do not name sites or apps); if the birth time is unknown, use a noon chart and skip the Ascendant and houses.
- P3 My Chart at a Glance: rows Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, North Node, Ascendant, Midheaven; columns Sign | Degree | House | Retrograde (Y/N).
- P4 My Chart Wheel: how to copy positions onto the blank wheel art (Ascendant at the left, houses 1-12 running counterclockwise).
- Weeks 1-12, three pages each: (a) Lesson, 350-450 words, with one worked example using an invented sample chart; (b) Worksheet with fill-in lines tied to the reader's own chart; (c) Reflection: three prompts, a "What resonates / What doesn't" two-column box, and "Questions I still have".
  Topics: 1 What a birth chart is (Sun, Moon and planet positions as seen from the birthplace at the birth moment; the tropical zodiac most Western astrologers use vs the sidereal zodiac used in Vedic astrology; signs are not the same as constellations). 2 The 12 signs through elements and modalities. 3 Sun and Moon. 4 Mercury, Venus, Mars. 5 Jupiter and Saturn. 6 Uranus, Neptune, Pluto (Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet in 2006; astrologers still use it). 7 The Ascendant and the four angles. 8 The 12 houses, and why house systems (Placidus, Whole Sign, Equal) give different results. 9 Planets in houses. 10 Aspects: conjunction 0, sextile 60, square 90, trine 120, opposition 180 degrees; orbs are a convention that varies. 11 Rulerships, retrograde as apparent motion seen from Earth, the lunar nodes. 12 Putting it together: a one-page "chart portrait" in the reader's own words.
  Label P2-P4 and Weeks 1-4 "[SAMPLE]" (they become the free sample).
- Reference tables: Signs (sign, glyph, approximate tropical dates, element, modality, traditional ruler, modern ruler); Planets (planet, glyph, 3-4 neutral themes); Houses (house, commonly associated life areas).
- Glossary: 40 terms, alphabetical, one or two sentences each.
- Keep Learning: five practice ideas using the workbook and invented sample charts.

DESIGN (one layout line per page)
US Letter 8.5x11 in, plus an A4 version; 0.6 in margins; headings Cormorant Garamond, body Lato 11 pt; palette "Night Study": Ink Navy #1F2A44, Parchment #F6F1E7, Brass Gold #C9A227, Dusty Lilac #B8A9C9, Slate #5B6475. Write planet and sign names in full beside every glyph.

CONTENT RULES
Original wording only. Warm, curious, plain tone, about an 8th-grade reading level. Use framing like "astrologers traditionally associate..." or "many practitioners read...", never statements of fact about the reader. Accuracy checks: fire = Aries, Leo, Sagittarius; earth = Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn; air = Gemini, Libra, Aquarius; water = Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces; cardinal = Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn; fixed = Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius; mutable = Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces; traditional/modern rulers of Scorpio Mars/Pluto, Aquarius Saturn/Uranus, Pisces Jupiter/Neptune; sign dates are approximate and shift by a day in some years; the Sun and Moon never go retrograde.

WHY THIS IS BETTER
Unlike sun-sign decor and horoscope journals, it teaches the method: each week builds on the last, everything is applied to the reader's own chart, and the "What doesn't resonate" box welcomes skeptics.

CONSTRAINTS
No predictions, forecasts, compatibility verdicts, or claims about health, money, love or success. No names of astrologers, books, websites, apps, celebrities or real people's charts. No copied text.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Page by page: "=== PAGE [n]: [title] ===", then "Layout:" (one line), then the exact text, with fill-in lines as "______" and tables as pipe tables. If you run out of space, stop at a page break and wait for "continue". End with:
SELF-CHECK (answer yes/no; fix any "no" before replying): every page is present; 12 weeks x 3 pages; elements, modalities and rulers match the checks above; no predictions or outcome promises; no brand, site, app or person names; all wording original.

No hands, no brand labels. No logos, no real people, no trademarked characters, no watermarks.

assembly: Paste the super prompt into Claude or ChatGPT. If the reply stops early, type "continue from PAGE [n]". Save the full text in one document.

Check accuracy yourself before designing: compare the signs table (elements, modalities, rulers, approximate dates), house order and aspect angles against two reputable beginner astrology references, and delete any sentence that predicts or promises anything.

In Canva, create a US Letter design (8.5 x 11 in). Build three master pages (Lesson, Worksheet, Reflection) in the Night Study palette with Cormorant Garamond and Lato, duplicate them for Weeks 1-12, and paste in the text. Type glyphs next to full names; if a glyph shows as a box, drop it and keep the name.
Run the chart-wheel SVG prompt, save the code as chart-wheel.svg, upload it to Canva, and place it on page 4 and in the Week 7-9 worksheets. Add the cover art and set the title in Canva.
Export the Letter file: Share > Download > PDF Print (300 DPI). For A4, use Canva's Resize (paid plan) or copy the pages into a new A4 design, check nothing is cut off, and export PDF Print.

Tablet version: duplicate the Letter design, add a contents page, link each entry to its page (select text > Link > page in this document), export PDF Standard, and test every link in a PDF reader on a tablet.
Free sample: download only the [SAMPLE] pages (Select pages in the download panel) as a separate PDF and upload it to Gumroad as a $0+ product so downloaders leave an email.

If the sample passes the Day 21 check, upload the Letter PDF, A4 PDF and tablet PDF to the Etsy digital listing (up to 5 files, 20 MB each) and to Gumroad, with 5 listing images made in Canva from the mockup.
products.listingPrompt:
You are an Etsy SEO copywriter. Write the Etsy listing for my digital product "[PRODUCT TITLE]": a 12-week printable workbook that teaches beginners to read their own birth chart (Western astrology) as a reflective practice, with no predictions. Files: US Letter PDF, A4 PDF and a hyperlinked tablet PDF; [PAGE COUNT] pages. Buyer: Gen Z and millennial beginners who want to learn astrology themselves instead of reading horoscopes.

Produce:
1. TITLE under 140 characters that starts with the buyer's search phrase (for example "Learn Astrology Workbook" or "Birth Chart Workbook for Beginners"), then the key features. Give 3 options and mark your pick.
2. 13 TAGS, each 20 characters or fewer (show the character count next to each), no repeats, mixing phrases around birth chart, natal chart, astrology for beginners, astrology workbook, printable and gift.
3. DESCRIPTION: a two-line opener on what it does; "What's inside" bullets (week-by-week topics, Chart at a Glance, blank chart wheel, reference tables, glossary); "Files and sizes" (formats, page sizes, page count); "How delivery works" (instant download from your Etsy Purchases page after payment; nothing ships; print at home or at a print shop; the tablet PDF opens in PDF annotation apps); "Good to know" (it teaches a symbolic, reflective practice and makes no predictions; you need your birth date, time and place and any free online chart calculator); one line saying AI tools helped create the content and I edited and checked it; personal-use terms.
4. FAQ with 5 short Q&As: Do I need my exact birth time? Is this a horoscope? Can I use it on a tablet? Can I print it more than once? Refunds (answer: [YOUR REFUND POLICY]).

Rules: original wording; no trademarked or brand names (no apps, websites, chart-calculator brands, astrology or tarot brands, celebrities); keep note-taking app and device names out of the title and tags; no promises about the future, personality truths, love, money, health or success; no "best" or "#1" claims; plain US English.

pricing.rationale: A 40+ page course-style workbook can sit above single-page astrology printables but well below paid courses; start at $14 and test $9 only if favorites come without sales.
pricing.basis: estimate: no marketplace prices were checked in the research; confirm against the Day 0 marketplace check

costs.basis: estimate: digital download, no production or shipping cost. Etsy fees (estimate, verify on Etsy's fee page): $0.20 listing fee, 6.5% transaction fee, about 3% + $0.25 payment processing per US sale.
costs.testBudgetNote: $0 during the free-sample test. If the Day 21 check is a go, an optional Etsy Ads test at $1/day for 14 days (about $14) after the full listing goes live.

launchPlan.action: Marketplace check: search Etsy and Amazon for "learn astrology workbook", "birth chart workbook" and "astrology for beginners printable"; log the top 10 results' prices and review counts in a sheet. Several well-reviewed beginner workbooks at similar prices is a stop signal.

Publish the free sample on Gumroad as a $0+ product, with a short receipt note saying the full 12 weeks is coming in November. Write down your go bar now (suggestion: 30+ signups by Day 21; this is a starting guess, not a benchmark).

GO / PIVOT / STOP. Go if sample downloads and signups show real pull: build Weeks 5-12 and list on Etsy and Gumroad by about Nov 20. Pivot if people download but say they won't pay for 12 weeks: sell a short $5 "chart reading starter kit" (Chart at a Glance, wheel, reference tables, glossary). asymmetry.downside: About 8 hours to build the free sample, then about 12 more for the full workbook, only if the sample pulls. Cash is close to $0 (Gumroad free product; $0.20 per Etsy listing later). You get an answer in 3 weeks (Nov 2).
asymmetry.upside: Zero marginal cost per sale. People searching to learn are less tied to one season than planner buyers, so it can sell well past January. The sample builds an email list you own, and the workbook anchors a series (starter kit, tarot journal, moon planner) that can sell on Etsy, Gumroad, Payhip and later as a paperback.
asymmetry.badBetIf: The Day 0 check shows several well-reviewed beginner astrology workbooks at similar prices, or you can't verify astrological conventions yourself (accuracy mistakes in a teaching product bring bad reviews fast). Competition was not measured in the research, so treat this as a test, not a sure thing.

risks: Competition is unmeasured: the research ran out of budget before a marketplace check, so do the Day 0 check before building more than the sample.
Accuracy: wrong rulerships, house order or aspect angles in a teaching product will draw complaints; verify against two references.
Etsy restricts metaphysical services that promise outcomes; keep this an educational printable and never sell readings or results (check Etsy's current Prohibited Items policy).
Interest may turn out to be a September 'reset' bump, which the research lists as an invalidator.
Keywords are untested suggestions; check Etsy search autocomplete before using them as tags.
AI-written lessons can sound generic; add your own worked example and voice before listing.

products.superPrompt:
You are a planner designer and a careful, astronomy-literate editor. Your goal: write the complete content and page plan for a dated 2027 moon-phase reflection planner, delivered as a hyperlinked tablet PDF and a printable PDF.

BUYER AND JOB
The buyer is setting New Year intentions and enjoys moon and celestial rituals. The planner gives them an accurate 2027 lunar calendar, a calm place to set intentions at each new moon and reflect at each full moon, and a monthly reset.

DATES: USE ONLY WHAT IS PASTED HERE
2027 moon phases in US Eastern Time (from the US Naval Observatory, cross-checked):
[PASTE TABLE: phase | date | time ET]
2027 eclipses (from NASA's eclipse website):
[PASTE TABLE: date | type | where visible]
Never generate, estimate or fill in a moon-phase or eclipse date yourself. If a table is missing, stop and ask for it. Calendar facts: January 1, 2027 is a Friday; 2027 is not a leap year; US daylight saving time runs March 14 to November 7, 2027.

DELIVERABLE (number every page)
1 Cover: "2027 Moon Phase & Intentions Planner", "[YOUR SHOP NAME]".
2 How to use: one new-moon page and one full-moon page per lunation; times are Eastern; in other time zones a phase can fall on the neighboring date.
3 About the Moon (factual, about 150 words): phases come from how much of the Moon's sunlit half we see; one cycle takes about 29.5 days; the phase is the same everywhere on Earth but the clock time, and sometimes the date, differ by time zone; solar eclipses happen only at new moon and lunar eclipses only at full moon.
4 2027 at a Glance: 12 mini-calendars (Sunday start) with a phase symbol on each pasted date.
5 My 2027 Intentions: three words for the year, what I want to practice, what I want to make room for, how I'll check in.
6 Lunar Dates: the pasted table, reformatted.
For each month, January to December:
- Monthly Reset (2 pages): month grid with phase symbols on the pasted dates; Look Back (what happened, what I learned); Look Ahead (focus, 3 small actions, habit tracker of 5 rows x days in the month).
- One New Moon page per new moon in that month: date and time, "Intentions (up to 3)", "First small step", "What support do I need?", "What I want to notice".
- One Full Moon page per full moon in that month: date and time, "What I noticed this cycle", "What's working", "What I'm ready to set down", "Gratitude".
- One Notes page.
- An Eclipse Note page after any month containing a pasted eclipse: date, type, visibility, one reflection prompt.
Finish with Year in Review (2 pages) and Notes.

DESIGN
Tablet PDF: 1620x2160 px portrait, right-edge tab strip (Year, Jan-Dec, Notes). Printable: US Letter 8.5x11 in and A4, no tabs, 0.5 in margins. Headings Playfair Display, body Montserrat Light. Palette "Moonlit Linen": Midnight #1B2033, Moon Cream #F4EFE6, Silver Mist #C7CBD1, Soft Gold #D4B26A, Dusk Blue #4A5878. Fine celestial line art, lots of white space. Phase symbols: waxing phases are lit on the right, waning on the left (Northern Hemisphere view).

CONTENT RULES
Original, calm, grounded wording at about an 8th-grade level. Prompts invite reflection; they never claim the Moon causes anything. No horoscopes, sign-by-sign forecasts or named full moons.

WHY THIS IS BETTER
Dates come from an authoritative source with the time zone stated; pages are for reflection, not horoscopes; the design is clean and quiet instead of crowded.

CONSTRAINTS
No predictions; no claims about the Moon's effect on health, sleep, mood, fertility, money, plants or relationships; no "manifest" promises. No brand, app or planner names; no copied layouts.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Page by page: "=== PAGE [n]: [title] ===", "Layout:" (one line), then exact text with fill-in lines "______". Write repeating pages once as a template, then list every instance with its page number and date. Then a HYPERLINK MAP: every tab and index entry with its target page number. End with:
SELF-CHECK (fix any "no" before answering): every phase and eclipse date comes from the pasted tables; the number of new-moon and full-moon pages equals the table rows; each month grid starts on the correct 2027 weekday; no predictions or effect claims; no brand names; all wording original.

assembly: Get the dates: open the US Naval Observatory (USNO) Astronomical Applications "Phases of the Moon" data for 2027 (times are in UT). Convert to Eastern Time: subtract 5 hours, or 4 hours between March 14 and November 7, 2027; a phase before midnight ET moves to the earlier date. Cross-check every row against NASA's moon-phase tables, and copy the 2027 eclipse list from NASA's eclipse website.
Paste both tables into the super prompt and run it. Reject and regenerate any output that contains a date not in your table.

In Canva, create a custom 1620 x 2160 px design. Build masters (Monthly Reset 2-page spread, New Moon page, Full Moon page, Notes page) with a right-edge tab strip, in the Moonlit Linen palette with Playfair Display and Montserrat Light. Duplicate per month and paste in the text.
Place moon symbols only on the dates in your table, using the icon set or two overlapping circles, and check that waxing phases are lit on the right.
Link every tab and index entry (select > Link > page in this document), export PDF Standard, and test every link in a PDF annotation app on a tablet.
Printable: copy the pages into a new US Letter design without tabs (0.5 in margins) and export PDF Print (300 DPI); repeat for A4.
Build the control listing for the validation test: a plain 2027 monthly planner made from the same calendar grids without the moon pages, at the same price.
Upload the tablet PDF, Letter PDF and A4 PDF to Etsy (up to 5 files, 20 MB each) and Gumroad, with 5 listing images from the tablet and flat-lay mockups.

products.superPrompt:
You are a patient tarot teacher and a book designer. Your goal: write the complete text and page plan for a beginner tarot STUDY journal: a log for learning one's own deck, not an interpretation book.

BUYER AND JOB
The buyer is a tarot beginner who just got a deck (they search "tarot cards for beginners"). The journal gives them one page per card to record what they learn from their own deck and guidebook, a spread log, and weekly pages for noticing patterns.

DELIVERABLE: 150 pages, number every page
1 Title: "[PRODUCT TITLE]", subtitle "A study journal for learning all 78 cards", "[YOUR SHOP NAME]".
2 How to Use: study one card a day (78 days) or one suit at a time; use your own deck's images and guidebook; log every practice spread.
3 How a Tarot Deck Is Organized: 78 cards; 22 Major Arcana numbered 0-21; 56 Minor Arcana in four suits of 14 (Ace to 10, Page, Knight, Queen, King); some decks rename suits (Coins or Disks for Pentacles) or court cards; Strength and Justice are numbered 8 and 11 in some traditions and 11 and 8 in others, so follow your deck.
4 Suits and Elements: the most common modern pairing is Wands-Fire, Cups-Water, Swords-Air, Pentacles-Earth; some readers swap Wands and Swords. Table plus "My deck uses: ______".
5 My Decks: deck name, date acquired, first impressions (3 blocks).
6 About Reversals: an optional practice; some readers use them and some don't; "My approach: ______".
7-8 78-Card Checklist: every card name with three boxes (Studied | Pulled in a spread | Revisited).
9-86 One page per card, in this order: 0 The Fool, I The Magician, II The High Priestess, III The Empress, IV The Emperor, V The Hierophant, VI The Lovers, VII The Chariot, VIII Strength, IX The Hermit, X Wheel of Fortune, XI Justice, XII The Hanged Man, XIII Death, XIV Temperance, XV The Devil, XVI The Tower, XVII The Star, XVIII The Moon, XIX The Sun, XX Judgement, XXI The World; then Wands, Cups, Swords and Pentacles, each Ace, Two to Ten, Page, Knight, Queen, King. Card page fields: header (name, number or suit); Date first studied; What I see in my deck's image (colors, figures, symbols, mood); Keywords from my guidebook (and which book); My own keywords; Upright notes; Reversed notes (optional); Questions I have; "Came up in" log (date and spread, 8 rows).
87-122 Spread Log (36 pages): date; deck; spread name; question or focus; sketch box for the layout; table Position | Card | What I noticed (10 rows); Overall reflection; Looking back a week later.
123-124 Spread Templates: a 3-card layout with blank position labels and example label sets (past / present / next step; situation / challenge / next step); a 10-position layout with numbered positions only.
125-146 Weekly "What I Noticed" pages (22): suits that showed up most, cards I keep drawing, a card that confused me, what I want to study next.
147-150 Notes and "Cards I Want to Revisit".

DESIGN
Two outputs from the same content. Paperback interior: 6x9 in, no bleed, 0.5 in margins on all sides, black ink. Printable: US Letter 8.5x11 in and A4. Headings Cinzel, body Lora 10.5 pt. Palette "Candle & Ink" (cover and printable accents): Ink #1E1B22, Bone #F3EEE3, Oxblood #7A2E35, Antique Gold #B8975A, Smoke #8C8790. Writing lines 50% gray. No card images inside.

CONTENT RULES
Write original text for pages 2-6 and all prompts, friendly and practical, about an 8th-grade level. Do NOT write meanings or interpretations for any card. Describe tarot as a reflective practice that people approach in different ways.

WHY THIS IS BETTER
It is a study log, not another meanings book: it works with any deck, it builds a record of what the reader actually learned, and it pairs with a learn-astrology workbook as a matching set.

CONSTRAINTS
No predictions, and no promises of insight, luck, love or success. No deck, publisher, artist or author names. No guidebook text. No reproduction or description of any copyrighted card artwork.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Page by page: "=== PAGE [n]: [title] ===", "Layout:" (one line), then exact text. For pages 9-86 give ONE card-page template, then a numbered list of the 78 headers in order. Do the same for spread-log and weekly pages (one template plus the page range). End with:
SELF-CHECK (fix any "no"): 78 headers = 22 Major + 4 x 14 Minor; no card meanings anywhere; page total is 150; no brand or person names; no predictions; wording original.
